title: Air-fryer chicken over rice with broccoli
description: Smoky air-fried chicken breast and crisp-edged broccoli over plain rice, with a quick lemon yogurt sauce.
freeze_note: Freeze the chicken, rice and broccoli; make the yogurt-lemon sauce fresh.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app.

steps.text: Cut the chicken into even 1-inch-thick pieces. Toss with half the oil, the garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, 3/4 tsp of the salt and the pepper.
Bring the water to a boil, add the rinsed rice and a pinch of salt, cover and simmer on low 15 minutes, then rest 10 minutes off the heat.
Air fry the chicken in a single layer at 400F for 18 minutes, flipping at 9, until cooked through.
Toss the broccoli with the remaining oil and salt. Air fry at 400F for 8 to 10 minutes, shaking once, until the edges brown.
Stir the yogurt with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt for the sauce.
Divide the rice, chicken and broccoli among 4 containers, with the sauce in small cups.
Reheat covered, stirring halfway. Add the sauce after reheating.
